decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 22nd September 2004, the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The chauffeur business involving the use of a room within the existing dwelling as an office area, as described in detail in applicant's email dated 4th October 2004 (i.e. he would be the only employee, he would also live in the dwelling, there would be no signage and there would be no pick ups or drop offs at the house) would not require planning permission, as it would not result in a material change of use to the dwelling or part thereof and is therefore considered to be ancillary to the property's residential use.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the use of one room in a dwellinghouse to operate as an office for a chauffeur service.
